## Selected work

### DevRelOS
Repository: https://github.com/savisaluwadana/DevRelOS

A developer-intelligence operating system for signal discovery, community and content workflows, developer feedback, campaigns, media workflows and measurable outcomes. The self-hosted architecture uses a Next.js operator dashboard, Go API and workers, PostgreSQL and an authenticated MCP server.

### Property Management OS
Repository: https://github.com/RealEstateSassApplication/property-management-OS

A multi-tenant rental operations platform covering properties, units, owners, tenants, leases, rent, maintenance, documents, notifications and controlled agent-assisted operations. The system uses Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL, OIDC/JWT, organization-scoped RBAC, S3-compatible storage, transactional outbox delivery, OpenAPI and MCP.

### RapidReach
Repository: https://github.com/savisaluwadana/RapidReachBloWebsite

A developer publication and developer-tool discovery product built with Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB and Vercel Blob. It includes editorial workflows, comments, likes, search, tool profiles, media uploads and structured discovery surfaces for search engines and agents.

### Avara Real Estate
Repository: https://github.com/RealEstateSassApplication/AvaraRealEstate

A Sri Lankan property platform for rentals, property sales and short-term bookings. It includes advanced search, role-based users, property management, availability and booking workflows, PayHere payment integration, S3 media storage and admin operations.

### Blu.lk
Website: https://blu.lk/

A Sri Lankan home-services platform connecting customers with vetted skilled professionals. The product includes service discovery, customer booking workflows, provider and worker operations, payments, scheduling and service fulfillment across home-service categories.

### FreshPick / FreshOnTime
Website: https://freshpick.lk/

A premium food-commerce and recurring-delivery platform for Colombo, combining fresh groceries, local products, prepared meals, subscriptions, recurring purchasing and business ordering into one customer experience.

## Platform Engineering and DevOps
Savi works across the path from source code to reliable production: developer platforms, self-service workflows, Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, release automation, observability, reliability, debugging and operational safety. The goal is to reduce developer friction without hiding the underlying system so completely that it becomes difficult to understand or operate.

## Engineering principles
- Keep domain rules authoritative on the server.
- Prefer one clear system of record before adding parallel state systems.
- Treat agents as authenticated clients, not privileged back doors.
- Make automation observable and externally consequential actions inspectable.
- Build paved roads that reduce friction while preserving debuggability.
- Add distributed infrastructure when the workload requires it, not for appearance.
- Treat product, infrastructure and operations as parts of the same system.
